question: The municipal corporation of which city launched India’s first QR-Based Digital House Address System in July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indore Municipal Corporation (IMC)** achieved a significant milestone by launching India’s first **QR-Based Digital House Address System** in **July 2025**.
 
• This innovative system assigns a unique **Digital Address** to every household in the city, which is accessible through a **QR code** plate installed at the entrance of the property.
 
• The primary objective of this project is to simplify **urban navigation** and improve the efficiency of **municipal service delivery**, such as waste management and emergency response.
 
• The **Digital Address** system integrates various datasets, including **Property Tax** records, water connection details, and **Geospatial** coordinates, into a single scannable interface.
 
• By implementing this system, **Indore** has become the first city in India to transition from traditional, often confusing physical addresses to a precise, **digitized location framework**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Smart Cities Mission:**
 
 
• The **Smart Cities Mission** was launched by the **Government of India** in **June 2015** to promote sustainable and inclusive cities.
 
• **Indore** has consistently been a frontrunner in this mission, utilizing **Information and Communication Technology (ICT)** to enhance the quality of government services.
 
 
 
• **Indore's Cleanliness Legacy:**
 
 
• **Indore**, located in **Madhya Pradesh**, is widely recognized for its cleanliness and has been ranked as India's **cleanest city** for multiple consecutive years in the **Swachh Survekshan** survey.
 
• The introduction of the **QR-based system** further strengthens its **Solid Waste Management** tracking by ensuring that every house is covered during collection rounds.
 
 
 
• **Digital India Initiative:**
 
 
• The **Digital India** campaign, launched in **2015**, aims to ensure that government services are available to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and internet connectivity.
 
• Digital addressing is a subset of this vision, facilitating easier **E-commerce** deliveries, postal services, and **Logistics** management.
 
 
 
• **Technological Integration:**
 
 
• The system utilizes **GIS (Geographic Information System)** mapping to provide exact locations, which is particularly useful for **Ambulance** and **Fire Services** in navigating narrow urban lanes.
 
• It also helps the **Municipal Corporation** in identifying unauthorized constructions and ensuring accurate **Property Valuation** and revenue collection.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Benefits of the System:**
 
 
• **Ease of Navigation:** Visitors and service providers can find exact locations using a simple **Unique Digital Code** or scanning the **QR code**.
 
• **Emergency Efficiency:** Reduces response time for **Emergency Services** like the **Police** or **Disaster Management** teams by eliminating address ambiguity.
 
• **Data Centralization:** All civic amenities linked to a property are unified under one **Digital ID**, promoting transparency in **Governance**.
 
 
 
• **Future Scope:**
 
 
• Following **Indore's** success, other major cities like **Hyderabad**, **Jaipur**, and **Bengaluru** are expected to adopt similar **Digital Addressing** frameworks under the **National Urban Digital Mission**.
